# Fred Wright & Gilbert Blythe

- [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) — Comrade of — [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — fellow officer and member of the Avonlea Village Improvement Society · since v2  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P8](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0008), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P48](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0048), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) continue canvassing [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for subscriptions, encountering peculiar neighbors like the hyper-neat Mrs. Theodore White and receiving mixed results. Learning that [Lorenzo White](../character/lorenzo-white.md) just had a new baby boy, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) strategically visits him while he is overjoyed, securing a generous five-dollar donation. Later that evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) to ask for a contribution, but he flatly refuses.
>
> — v2 · VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P37](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0037), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P44](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0044), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P49](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0049), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P56](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0056)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) regarding Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and the ongoing hall improvement project. Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) paints the hall a shocking bright blue due to a mix-up with the paint numbers, news spreads across town. [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Fred](../character/fred-wright.md), [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and Oliver gather with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) in shared dismay over the disaster.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P0](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0000), [v2 IX A Question of Color P24](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0024), [v2 IX A Question of Color P28](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0028), [v2 IX A Question of Color P32](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0032)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> As wedding preparations for Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) continue, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) express their excitement about moving to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston). Meanwhile, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects on romance with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and later stumbles upon [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) sharing an intimate moment. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to confide her engagement to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), leading [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to ponder her own future dreams of love.
>
> — v2 · XXIX Poetry and Prose

_Sources: [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P2](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0002), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P5](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0005), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P11](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0011), [v2 XXIX Poetry and Prose P15](../source/v02-c29.md#nw-v02-c29-p0015)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) prepare for her wedding to [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md) at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), reflecting on their lifelong friendship. After the ceremony, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) back toward [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and they take a stroll through Lovers' Lane, where they converse about their summer plans and changing lives.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXIX Diana’s Wedding

_Sources: [v3 ch.Wedding P0](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0000), [v3 ch.Wedding P12](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0012), [v3 ch.Wedding P13](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0013), [v3 ch.Wedding P17](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0017)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) wakes up on her wedding day at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and reflects on her time in her childhood room. Friends and family gather for the wedding ceremony in the orchard, after which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) depart on the train for [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary.
